result.one_liner: LiveAgent is a cloud-based customer support and helpdesk software with live chat, ticketing, and multichannel communication capabilities.

evidence.quote: An API key is an identity of your LiveAgent which you can use to build your own custom integration solutions.
For OAuth2 authentication, the documentation mentions configuring an access token for authorization.
REST API documentation available for integration solutions.
LiveAgent offers a 30-day free trial with no credit card required. API and integrations are included in each subscription.
Pricing plans start at $15/agent/month with no free tier available.

result.notes: LiveAgent provides REST API access via API key authentication. OAuth2 and bearer token support are mentioned in documentation. API is available to all paid subscribers (starting at $15/agent/month) and during the 30-day free trial. No permanent free tier or self-serve sandbox available. API breadth unknown from available documentation.
